title: Global Stafford
summary: Lean formalization of the same-divisor identity 1 = d*R + F*d*S in the ring of k-linear finite-order differential operators of every smooth integral finitely generated algebra over a characteristic-zero field, extending Stafford's Conjecture 3.8 from Weyl algebras to smooth affine varieties.

review.reason: Lean formalization extending Stafford's same-divisor identity to smooth affine varieties.
